1.word_for_word: ऊनत्रिंशे तु रासार्थम् उक्ति-प्रात्युक्तयो हरेः । — In the thirty-ninth section, the utterances and replies of the Lord are for the sake of the Rāsa.; गोपीभी रास-संरम्भे तस्य चान्तर्धि-कौतुकम् ॥अ॥ — The gopis were enraged at the Rasa and the curiosity of his innermost being.; ब्रह्मादि-जय-संरूढ-दर्प-कन्दर्प-दर्पहा । — Brahma-adi-jaya-sanrudha-darpa-kandarpa-darpaha.; जयति श्री-पतिर् गोपी-रास-मण्डल-मण्डनः ॥ब्॥ — Jayati Sri-patir gopi-rasa-mandala-mandana.b.; ननु विपरीतम् इदम्, पर-दार-विनोदेन कन्दर्प-विजेतृत्व-प्रतीतेः । — Indeed, this is the opposite, since Cupid is perceived as a conqueror by the entertainment of another’s wife.; मैवम्, योग-मायाम् उपाश्रितः [भा।पु। — Not so, relying on the illusion of yoga [Bh.p.; १०.२९.१], आत्मारामोऽप्य् अरीरमत् [भा।पु। — 10.29.1], Atmarama'pi ariramat [Bh.p.; १०.२९.४२], साक्षान् मन्मथ- मन्मथः [भा।पु। — 10.29.42], directly Manmatha- Manmatha [Bh.p.; १०.३२.२], आत्मन्य् अवरुद्ध-सौरतः [भा।पु। — 10.32.2], atmany avaruddha-saurata [Bh.p.; १०.३३.१७] इत्य्-आदिषु स्वातन्त्र्याभिधानात् । — 10.33.17] etc., because of the statement of independence.; तस्माद् रास-क्रीडा-विडम्बनं काम-विजय-ख्यापनायेत्य् एव तत्त्वम् । — Therefore, the irony of the Rāsa games is to proclaim the victory over lust.; किं च, शृङ्गार-कथापदेशेन विशेषतो निवृत्ति-परा इयं पञ्चाध्यायीति व्यक्तीकरिष्यामः । — Moreover, we shall express that this five-chapter is especially devoted to renunciation by teaching the story of aesthetics.; ता रात्रीः याताबला व्रजं सिद्धा मयेमा रंस्यथ क्षपाः [भा।पु। — Those nights are gone, and I have perfected Vraja, and you will enjoy these nights [Bh.P.; १०.२२.२७] इति प्रतिश्रुता इत्य् अर्थः ॥१॥ — 10.22.27] means that they are promised.
1.translation: In the thirty-ninth section, the utterances and replies of the Lord are for the sake of the Rāsa. The gopis were enraged at the Rasa and the curiosity of his innermost being. Brahma-adi-jaya-sanrudha-darpa-kandarpa-darpaha. Jayati Sri-patir gopi-rasa-mandala-mandana.b. Indeed, this is the opposite, since Cupid is perceived as a conqueror by the entertainment of another’s wife. Not so, relying on the illusion of yoga [Bh.p. 10.29.1], Atmarama'pi ariramat [Bh.p. 10.29.42], directly Manmatha- Manmatha [Bh.p. 10.32.2], atmany avaruddha-saurata [Bh.p. 10.33.17] etc., because of the statement of independence. Therefore, the irony of the Rāsa games is to proclaim the victory over lust. Moreover, we shall express that this five-chapter is especially devoted to renunciation by teaching the story of aesthetics. Those nights are gone, and I have perfected Vraja, and you will enjoy these nights [Bh.P. 10.22.27] means that they are promised.

2.word_for_word: तदा तस्मिन्न् एव क्षणे तत्-प्रतीतये उडु-राजश् चन्द्र उदगाद् उदितः । — Then, at that very moment, the moon, the king of the moon, rose from the east to perceive it.; किं कुर्वन् ? — What are you doing?; दीर्घ-कालेन दर्शनं यस्य स प्रियः स्व-प्रियाया मुखम् अरुणेन कुङ्कुमेन यथा विलिम्पति तथा प्राच्याः ककुभो दिशो मुखं शन्तमैः सुखतमैः करै रश्मिभिर् अरुणेनोदय-रागेण विलिम्पन्न् अरुणीकुर्वन्न् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that just as a lover who has been seen for a long time smears the face of his beloved with red saffron, so the eastern sky smears the face of the directions with the calm and pleasant rays of the sunrise with the passion of the sunrise.; स प्रसिद्ध उडु-राजः । — He is the famous Udu-raja.; तथा चर्षणीनां जनानां शुचस् ताप-ग्लानीर् मृजन्न् अपनयन् ॥२॥ — Thus He wiped away the sorrows, sufferings and sorrows of the people who were watching.
2.translation: Then, at that very moment, the moon, the king of the moon, rose from the east to perceive it. What are you doing? This means that just as a lover who has been seen for a long time smears the face of his beloved with red saffron, so the eastern sky smears the face of the directions with the calm and pleasant rays of the sunrise with the passion of the sunrise. He is the famous Udu-raja. Thus He wiped away the sorrows, sufferings and sorrows of the people who were watching.

3.word_for_word: कुमुत् कुमुदं विकसनीयं विद्यते यस्य तं कुमुद्वन्तम् । — A lily is a lily that has to be developed.; न खण्डं मण्डलं यस्य तम् । — That which has no piece of circle.; रमाया आननस्याभेव आभा यस्य तम् । — The one whose face is as bright as the face of the goddess of fortune.; नव-कुङ्कुमम् इवारुणम् एवं-विधं चन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा । — Seeing the moon as red as new saffron; तथा वनं च तस्य कोमलैर्गोभी रश्मिभी रञ्जितं दृष्ट्वा कलं मधुरं जगौ अगायत । — Seeing the forest illuminated by the tender rays of the cabbage tree the demon sang sweetly; कथम् ? — How's it going?; वाम-दृशां वामा मनोहरा दृशो यासां, तासां मनोहरं यथा ॥३॥ — Left-eyed women whose left-handed sight is attractive, as if they were attractive.
3.translation: A lily is a lily that has to be developed. That which has no piece of circle. The one whose face is as bright as the face of the goddess of fortune. Seeing the moon as red as new saffron Seeing the forest illuminated by the tender rays of the cabbage tree the demon sang sweetly How's it going? Left-eyed women whose left-handed sight is attractive, as if they were attractive.

4.word_for_word:
असापत्न्याय अन्योन्यम् अलक्षितो न ज्ञापित उद्यमो याभिस् ताः । — They are those who have not noticed or informed each other of their enterprise for the sake of their wives.; स कान्तो यत्र, तत्र गीत-ध्वनि-मार्गेण आजग्मुः । — They came to the place where that lover was, by the way of song and sound.; जवेन वेगेन लोलानि चञ्चलानि कुण्डलानि यासां ताः ॥४॥ — Those whose earrings are restlessly rolling with great speed.; : जग्मुर् इति वक्तव्ये आजग्मुर् इत्य् उक्तिः शुकस्य कृष्णान्तिके
स्वावस्थान-स्फूर्तेः ॥ — In the statement that they went, the saying that they came is near the black of the parrot
of the vibration of one’s own position.
4.translation:
They are those who have not noticed or informed each other of their enterprise for the sake of their wives. They came to the place where that lover was, by the way of song and sound. Those whose earrings are restlessly rolling with great speed. In the statement that they went, the saying that they came is near the black of the parrot
of the vibration of one’s own position.

5-7.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्ण-सूचक-शब्द-शर्वणेन तत्-प्रवण-चित्तानां तत्-क्षणम् एव त्रैवर्गिक-कर्म-निवृत्तिं द्योतयन्त्य इवार्धावसितं कर्म विहाय ययुः । — When they heard the words indicating Lord Kṛṣṇa, those whose minds were inclined to Him immediately abandoned their half-finished activities, as if indicating the renunciation of the threefold activities.; तद् आह---दुहन्त्य इति । — He argues that they are milking.; पयः स्थाली-स्थं चुल्ल्याम् अधिश्रित्यैतत् क्वाथमप्रतीक्षमानाः काश्चिद् ययुः । — Some of them left the milk in a pot on the stove waiting for it to boil.; संयावं गोधूम-कणान्नं पक्वम् अनुद्वास्यानुत्तार्य ॥५-६॥ — The mixture of wheat grains is cooked and the food is not driven out and lifted.5-6; अन्याः प्रमृजन्त्यः अङ्गोद्वर्तनादि कुर्वन्त्यः । — Others are wiping and lifting their limbs.; काश्च काश्चित् कृष्णतुष्ट्यर्थं कर्म तदासक्तम् अनसामन्यथा कृतम् अपि फलत्य् एवेति द्योतयन्न् आह---व्यत्यस्तेति । — Some others, pointing out that action for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa, which is attached to it and done in an uncommon way, still bears fruit, argue that it is interrupted.; स्थानतः स्वरूपतश् चोर्ध्वाधोधारणेन विपर्ययं प्राप्तानि वस्त्राभरणानि यासां ताः ॥७॥ — Those whose clothes and ornaments have been reversed by wearing them up and down from their place and appearance.
5-7.translation: When they heard the words indicating Lord Kṛṣṇa, those whose minds were inclined to Him immediately abandoned their half-finished activities, as if indicating the renunciation of the threefold activities. He argues that they are milking. Some of them left the milk in a pot on the stove waiting for it to boil. The mixture of wheat grains is cooked and the food is not driven out and lifted.5-6 Others are wiping and lifting their limbs. Some others, pointing out that action for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa, which is attached to it and done in an uncommon way, still bears fruit, argue that it is interrupted. Those whose clothes and ornaments have been reversed by wearing them up and down from their place and appearance.

8.word_for_word: न च कृष्णाकृष्ट-मनसां विघ्नाः प्रभवन्तीत्य् आह---ता वार्यमाणा इति ॥८॥ — Nor do obstacles arise for those whose minds are attracted to Kṛṣṇa, he argues, for they are forbidden.
8.translation: Nor do obstacles arise for those whose minds are attracted to Kṛṣṇa, he argues, for they are forbidden.

9.word_for_word: न लब्धो निर्गमो याभिस् ताः । — Those who have not found an exit.; प्राग् अपि तद्-भावना-युक्तास् तदा नितरां दध्युर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥९॥ — This means that even before they were endowed with that feeling they should then continue to meditate.
9.translation: Those who have not found an exit. This means that even before they were endowed with that feeling they should then continue to meditate.

10-11.word_for_word: किं च, तदानीम् एवं तं परमात्मानं कृष्णं ध्यानतः प्राप्ताः सत्यो गुण-मयं देहं जहुर् इत्य् आह श्लोक-द्वयेन---दुःसहेति । — Moreover, at that time, having thus attained that Supreme Soul, Kṛṣṇa, by meditation, they gave up their body of true qualities, he argues in two verses: “It is unbearable.”; ननु कथं जहुः परमात्मेति ज्ञानाभावाद् इत्य् आशङ्क्याह---जार-बुद्ध्यापीति । — If so, how could they abandon the Supreme Self because of the lack of knowledge?; न हि वस्तु-शक्तिर् बुद्धिम् अपेक्षते । — For the power of things does not require intelligence.; अन्यथा मत्वापि पीतामृतवद् इति भावः । — Even if you think otherwise, it is like yellow nectar.; ननु तद् अपि प्रारब्ध-कर्म-बन्धने सति कथं जहुस् तत्राह---सद्यः प्रक्षीण-बन्धना इति । — If so, how can they give up even that when they are bound by the actions they have started?; ननु कथं भोगम् अन्तरेण प्रारब्धं कर्म क्षीणं भोगेनैव सद्यः क्षीणम् इत्य् आह---दुःसहेति । — If so, how can action, which has been initiated by enjoyment, be destroyed immediately by enjoyment itself?; दुःसहो यः प्रेष्ठ-विरहस् तेन तीव्रस् तापस् तेन धुतानि गतान्य् अशुभानि यासाम् । — The unbearable separation from their beloved is the intense pain that has washed away their misfortunes.; तद्-अप्राप्ति-परम-दुःख-भोगेन पापं क्षीणम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that sin is exhausted by the enjoyment of the supreme suffering of not attaining it.; तथा ध्यानेन प्राप्ता अच्युतस्य आश्लेषेण या निर्वृतिः परम-सुख-भोगस् तया क्षीणं मङ्गलं पुण्य-बन्धनं यासां ताः । — Similarly, the satisfaction attained by meditation and the enjoyment of supreme bliss by embracing the infallible Lord has destroyed the bondage of pious auspiciousness.; अतो ध्यानेन परमात्म-प्राप्तेस् तत्-काल-सुख-दुःखाभ्यां निःशेष-कर्म-क्षयाद् गुण-मयं देहं जहुर् इति ॥१०-११॥ — Therefore, having attained the Supreme Self by meditation, they gave up the body made up of the modes of nature by the destruction of infinite actions at that time, happiness and pain.
10-11.translation: Moreover, at that time, having thus attained that Supreme Soul, Kṛṣṇa, by meditation, they gave up their body of true qualities, he argues in two verses: “It is unbearable.” If so, how could they abandon the Supreme Self because of the lack of knowledge? For the power of things does not require intelligence. Even if you think otherwise, it is like yellow nectar. If so, how can they give up even that when they are bound by the actions they have started? If so, how can action, which has been initiated by enjoyment, be destroyed immediately by enjoyment itself? The unbearable separation from their beloved is the intense pain that has washed away their misfortunes. This means that sin is exhausted by the enjoyment of the supreme suffering of not attaining it. Similarly, the satisfaction attained by meditation and the enjoyment of supreme bliss by embracing the infallible Lord has destroyed the bondage of pious auspiciousness. Therefore, having attained the Supreme Self by meditation, they gave up the body made up of the modes of nature by the destruction of infinite actions at that time, happiness and pain.

12.word_for_word: ननु यथा पति-पुत्रादीनां वस्तुतो ब्रह्मत्वेऽपि न तद्-भजनान् मोक्षः, तथा बुद्ध्य्-अभावाद् एवं कृष्णेऽपि ब्रह्म-बुद्ध्य्-अभावेन तत्-सङ्गतिः कथं मोक्ष-हेतुः ? — Indeed, just as husband, son and others, even though they are actually Brahmans, do not attain liberation by worshiping Him because of their lack of intelligence, so how can association with Krishna, even in the absence of Brahman-intelligence, be the cause of liberation?; इति शङ्कते---कृष्णं विदुर् इति । — He suspects that they know Krishna.; परं केवलं कान्तं कमनीयम् ॥१२॥ — But only lovely and adorable.
12.translation: Indeed, just as husband, son and others, even though they are actually Brahmans, do not attain liberation by worshiping Him because of their lack of intelligence, so how can association with Krishna, even in the absence of Brahman-intelligence, be the cause of liberation? He suspects that they know Krishna. But only lovely and adorable.

13.word_for_word: परिहरति---उक्तम् इति । — He avoids saying that it is said.; अयं भावः---जीवेष्व् आवृतं ब्रह्मत्वं, कृष्णस्य तु हृषीकेशत्वाद् अनावृतम् । — This means that the Brahman is covered in living beings, but uncovered by Kṛṣṇa, who is the Lord of the senses.; अतो न तत्र बुद्ध्य्-अपेक्षेति ॥१३॥ — Therefore there is no intellectual expectation.
13.translation: He avoids saying that it is said. This means that the Brahman is covered in living beings, but uncovered by Kṛṣṇa, who is the Lord of the senses. Therefore there is no intellectual expectation.

14.word_for_word: ननु देही कथम् अनावृतः स्याद् अत आह---नृणाम् इति । — If so, how can the embodied be uncovered?; गुणात्मनो गुण-नियन्तुः । — The quality-controller of the quality-self.; भगवत एवं-रूपा अभिव्यक्तिर् अतो न देही-सादृश्यम् अत्र वक्तुं युज्यत इति भावः ॥१४॥ — This is the expression of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in this form, and therefore it is not fitting to speak here of the similarity of the body.
14.translation: If so, how can the embodied be uncovered? The quality-controller of the quality-self. This is the expression of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in this form, and therefore it is not fitting to speak here of the similarity of the body.

15.word_for_word: अतो यथा कथञ्चित् तद्-आसक्तिर् मुक्ति-कारणम् इत्य् आह---कामम् इति । — Therefore, he argues that somehow attachment to it is the cause of liberation, namely, desire.; ऐक्यं सम्बन्धम् । — Unity is a relationship.; सौहृदं भक्तिम् ॥१५॥ — Friendship and devotion.
15.translation: Therefore, he argues that somehow attachment to it is the cause of liberation, namely, desire. Unity is a relationship. Friendship and devotion.

16.word_for_word: न च भगवतोऽयम् अतिभार इत्य् आह---न चैवम् इति । — Nor is this an excessive burden on the Lord, he argues.; यतः श्री-कृष्णाद् एतत् स्थावरादिकम् अपि विमुच्यते ॥१६॥ — Because of Lord Kṛṣṇa, even this immovable and other things are liberated.
16.translation: Nor is this an excessive burden on the Lord, he argues. Because of Lord Kṛṣṇa, even this immovable and other things are liberated.

17.word_for_word:
प्रस्तुतम् आह---ता दृष्ट्वेति । — He argues that he has seen the present.; वाचः-पेशैर् वाग्-विलासैः ॥१७॥ — with the muscles of speech and the pleasures of speech.; : रसमयरासलीलाप्रसङ्गे ईदृशस् ते प्रश्नः समाधानप्रपञ्चश् च
रसविघातकत्वाद् अनुचित इति व्यञ्जयन् स्वयम् एवोत्कण्ठया
प्रस्तौति॥ — Such is your question and the world of solutions in the case of Rasamaya Rasalila
Expressing himself anxiously that it was inappropriate because it disturbed the taste
Presentation.
17.translation:
He argues that he has seen the present. with the muscles of speech and the pleasures of speech. Such is your question and the world of solutions in the case of Rasamaya Rasalila
Expressing himself anxiously that it was inappropriate because it disturbed the taste
Presentation.

18.word_for_word: सर्वाः स-संभ्रमम् आगता विलोक्य स-भयम् इवाह---व्रजस्य इति ॥१८॥ — All of them came together in confusion and looking at him with fear he said, "You are from Vraja.
18.translation: All of them came together in confusion and looking at him with fear he said, "You are from Vraja.

19.word_for_word: लज्जया मन्द-हसितम् आलक्ष्याह---रजन्य् एषा इति ॥१९॥ — She noticed him smiling softly out of embarrassment and said, "This is the night.
19.translation: She noticed him smiling softly out of embarrassment and said, "This is the night.

20.word_for_word: किं च, मातर इति । — What’s more, it’s mothers.; विचिन्वन्ति मृगयन्ते । — They search and hunt.; बन्धूनां साध्वसं कृच्छ्रं मा कृध्वं मा कुरुतेत्य् अर्थः ॥२०॥ — This means that you should not cause fear or trouble to your relatives.
20.translation: What’s more, it’s mothers. They search and hunt. This means that you should not cause fear or trouble to your relatives.

21-22.word_for_word: ईषत्-प्रणय-कोपेनान्यतो विलोकयन्तीः प्रत्य् आह---दृष्टम् इति । — Looking away with a slight affectionate anger, she replied, "I have seen it.; राकेशस्य पूर्ण-चन्द्रस्य करै रञ्जितम् । — It was painted by the hands of the full moon of Rākeśa.; यमुना-स्पर्शिनोऽनिलस्य लीला मन्द-गतिः, तया एजन्तः कम्पमानास् तरूणां पल्लवाः, तैः शोभितम् ॥२१॥ — The slow movement of the wind touching the Yamuna, the leaves of the young trees trembling with it, adorned it.; सतीः ! — Satih!; हे सत्यः ! — O truth!; ॥२२॥ — ॥22॥
21-22.translation: Looking away with a slight affectionate anger, she replied, "I have seen it. It was painted by the hands of the full moon of Rākeśa. The slow movement of the wind touching the Yamuna, the leaves of the young trees trembling with it, adorned it. Satih! O truth! ॥22॥

23.word_for_word: संरम्भ-क्षुभित-दृष्टीः प्रत्य् आह---अथवा इति । — “Or else,” he replied, his eyes shaken with anger.; यन्त्रिताशया वशीकृत-चित्ताः । — They are controlled by their minds and subdued.; उपपन्नं युक्तम् । — It is appropriate to approach.; प्रीयन्ते प्रीता भवन्ति ॥२३॥ — They are pleased and are pleased.
23.translation: “Or else,” he replied, his eyes shaken with anger. They are controlled by their minds and subdued. It is appropriate to approach. They are pleased and are pleased.

24.word_for_word: दृष्टादृष्ट-भय-प्रदर्शनेन निवर्तयति---भर्तुर् इत्य्-आदि श्लोक-त्रयेण ॥२४-२५॥ — By showing fear of what is seen and what is not seen, he restrains them in three verses, beginning with the words “of the husband” (24-25).
24.translation: By showing fear of what is seen and what is not seen, he restrains them in three verses, beginning with the words “of the husband” (24-25).

26.word_for_word: फल्गु तुच्छम् । — Phalgu is insignificant.; कृच्छ्रं दुःसंपाद्यम् । — It’s difficult and difficult to accomplish.; औपपत्त्यं जार-सौख्यम् ॥२६॥ — The appropriateness of the jar-happiness.
26.translation: Phalgu is insignificant. It’s difficult and difficult to accomplish. The appropriateness of the jar-happiness.

27.word_for_word: किं च, श्रवणाद् इति ॥२७॥ — What is more, it is from hearing.
27.translation: What is more, it is from hearing.

29.word_for_word: चिन्तां प्राप्तानां स्थितिम् आह---कृत्वा इति । — He argues for the position of those who have attained anxiety: having done so.; शुचः शोकाद् उद्गतेन श्वसनेन शुष्यन्तो बिम्ब-फल-सदृशा अधरा येषु मुखेषु, तानि अव अवाञ्चि कृत्वा तथाऽङ्गुष्ठेन महीं लिखन्त्यः । — They lifted their lips, which were like image-fruit, and wrote on the ground with their thumbs, which were dry with the breath of grief.; तथा गृहीत-कज्जलैर् अश्रुभिः कुच-कुङ्कुमानि क्षलयन्त्यस् तूष्णीं स्थिताः । — They stood silently washing the saffron on their breasts with tears in their hands; यत उरु-दुःखस्य भरो भारो यासां ताः ॥२९॥ — Because the burden of thigh-pain is the burden of those who are burdened.
29.translation: He argues for the position of those who have attained anxiety: having done so. They lifted their lips, which were like image-fruit, and wrote on the ground with their thumbs, which were dry with the breath of grief. They stood silently washing the saffron on their breasts with tears in their hands Because the burden of thigh-pain is the burden of those who are burdened.

30.word_for_word: किं च, प्रेष्ठम् इति । — What’s more, it’s the best.; किञ्चित् संरम्भेन कोपावेशेन गद्गदा गिरो यासां, ता अब्रुवत स्म । — The women whose voices were choked with a little anger and anger spoke as follows.; संरम्भे कारणं---प्रेष्ठम् इत्य्-आदि । — The cause of anger is preferred, etc.; प्रियेतरम् इव प्रतिभाषमाणं प्रत्याचक्षाणम् ॥३०॥ — He replied as if he were his beloved
30.translation: What’s more, it’s the best. The women whose voices were choked with a little anger and anger spoke as follows. The cause of anger is preferred, etc. He replied as if he were his beloved

31.word_for_word: नृशंसं क्रूरम् । — It’s cruel and cruel.; हे दुरवग्रह स्वच्छन्द । — O evil-minded free-spirited.; तव पाद-मूलंभक्ताः सेवितवतीर् अस्मान् भजस्व मा त्यजेति ॥३१॥ — Devotees have served the root of Your feet, saying, 'Serve us and do not abandon us.
31.translation: It’s cruel and cruel. O evil-minded free-spirited. Devotees have served the root of Your feet, saying, 'Serve us and do not abandon us.

32.word_for_word: अपि च यद् उक्तम्पत्य्-अपत्य इत्य्-आदि त्वया धर्म-विदा इति सोपहासम् एव । — Moreover, what you have said about your wife and children, saying that you are a religious person, is a joke.; एतद् उपदेशानां पदे विषये त्वय्य् एवास्तु । — Let this be in you, in the matter of the steps of the instructions.; उपदेश-पदत्वे हेतुः---ईश इति । — The reason for being a precept term is that Ish.; विविदिषा-वाक्येन सर्वोपदेशानाम् ईश-परत्वावगमाद् इति भावः । — This means that by the statement of Vividīṣa, all precepts are understood to be God-oriented.; ईशत्वे हेतुः---आत्मा किल भवान् इति । — The reason for being divine is that you are the soul.; भोग्यस्य हि सर्वस्य भोक्ता आत्मैवेश इत्य् अतः प्रेष्ठो बन्धुश् च भवान् एवेति सर्व-बन्धुषु करणीयं त्वय्य् एवास्त्व् इत्य् अर्थः । — For the enjoyer of all that is enjoyable is the Self, and therefore You are the dearest friend.; अथ वा, धर्मोपदेशानां पदे स्थाने धर्मोपदेष्टरि त्वयि सति, अस्मासु च धर्मं जिज्ञासमानासु सतीषु त्वया धर्म-विदा यद् उक्तम् एवम् एतद् अस्तु । — Or else, while you are the teacher of religion at every step of the precepts of religion, and among us chaste women who are inquiring about religion, let this be so, as you, the knower of religion, have said.; न तु त्वं धर्मोपदेष्टा, किन्तु भवान् आत्मा इति । — It is not that you are a religious teacher, but that you are the soul.; अथ वा, यद् उक्तम् एतद् उपदेश-पदे तद्-गोचरे पुरुषेऽस्तु नाम, त्वयि तु ईशे स्वामिनि सत्य् एवम् । — Or, let what has been said in this precept be in the person who is visible to it, but it is true in you, Lord and Master.; काक्वा नैवम् इत्य् अर्थः । — That means that the crow doesn’t.; यतस् तनु-भृतां त्वम् आत्मा फल-रूप इति । — Because You are the soul and the form of the fruits of the embodied.; यद् वा, यद् उक्तं "पत्य्-आदि-शुश्रूषणं धर्म" इति एवम् एतत् त्वय्य् एवास्तु । — Or, as it is said, "Serving one's husband and others is the righteousness," so let this be in you.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; उपदेश-पदे शुश्रूषणीयत्वेन उपदिश्यमानानां पत्य्-आदीनां पदेऽधिष्ठाने । — When the husband and others are taught to be served in the position of instruction, they are placed in the position of instruction.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; ईशे, न हीश्वरम् अधिष्ठानं विना कोऽपि पति-पुत्रादिर् नामेति । — O Lord, no one calls Himself a husband, son or other person without His abode.; अन्यत् समानम् । — Otherwise the same.; अलम् अतिविस्तरेण॥३२॥ — Enough in too much detail.
32.translation: Moreover, what you have said about your wife and children, saying that you are a religious person, is a joke. Let this be in you, in the matter of the steps of the instructions. The reason for being a precept term is that Ish. This means that by the statement of Vividīṣa, all precepts are understood to be God-oriented. The reason for being divine is that you are the soul. For the enjoyer of all that is enjoyable is the Self, and therefore You are the dearest friend. Or else, while you are the teacher of religion at every step of the precepts of religion, and among us chaste women who are inquiring about religion, let this be so, as you, the knower of religion, have said. It is not that you are a religious teacher, but that you are the soul. Or, let what has been said in this precept be in the person who is visible to it, but it is true in you, Lord and Master. That means that the crow doesn’t. Because You are the soul and the form of the fruits of the embodied. Or, as it is said, "Serving one's husband and others is the righteousness," so let this be in you. Where is it from? When the husband and others are taught to be served in the position of instruction, they are placed in the position of instruction. Where is it from? O Lord, no one calls Himself a husband, son or other person without His abode. Otherwise the same. Enough in too much detail.

33.word_for_word: एतत् सद्-आचारेण द्रढयन्त्यः प्रार्थयन्ते---कुर्वन्ति इति । — They pray that they will do this, confirming it by good conduct.; कुशलाः शास्त्र-निपुणाः। — Skilled in the scriptures.; तथा च शास्त्रम्---किं प्रजया करिष्यामो येषां नोऽयम् आत्माऽयं च लोकः [बृ।आ।उ। — And so the scripture says: What shall we do with the progeny of those whom this soul and this world are ours [Br.A.U.; ४.४.२२] इति ॥३३॥ — 4.4.22] is the source.
33.translation: They pray that they will do this, confirming it by good conduct. Skilled in the scriptures. And so the scripture says: What shall we do with the progeny of those whom this soul and this world are ours [Br.A.U. 4.4.22] is the source.

34.word_for_word: किं च, प्रतियात [१०.२९.१९] इति यद् उक्तं, तद् अशक्यं, त्वयैव चित्तादीनाम् अपहृतत्वाद् इत्य् आहुः---चित्तम् इति । — Moreover, what is said, return [10.29.19], is impossible, since you have taken away the mind and other things, they say, the mind.; यद् अस्माकं चित्तम् एतावन्तं कालं सुखेन गृहेषु निर्विशति, तत् त्वया अपहृतम् । — You have taken away our minds that have been happily entering our homes for so long.; कराव् अपि यौ गृह्य-कृत्ये निर्विशतः, ताव् अपि । — Even the Karavs, who are involved in household chores, are also involved.; सुखात्मना त्वयेति वा ॥३४॥ — or by you, with a happy soul.
34.translation: Moreover, what is said, return [10.29.19], is impossible, since you have taken away the mind and other things, they say, the mind. You have taken away our minds that have been happily entering our homes for so long. Even the Karavs, who are involved in household chores, are also involved. or by you, with a happy soul.

35.word_for_word: अतः अङ्ग ! — So Ang!; हे कृष्ण ! — O Krishna!; नोऽस्माकं तवाधरामृत-पूरकेण तवैव हास-सहितेन अवलोकेन कल-गीतेन च जातो यो हृच्-छयाग्निः कामाग्निः, तं सिञ्च । — Sprinkle us with the fire of desire in our hearts, which has been kindled by the nectar of Your lips, by Your smile, by Your gaze and by Your song.; नो चेद् अयं तावद् एकोऽग्निः, तथा विरहात् जनिष्यते योऽग्निः, तेन च उपयुक्त-देहा दग्ध-शरीरा योगिन इव ते पदवीम् अन्तिकं ध्यानेन याम प्राप्नुयामः ॥३५॥ — If this is not so much the one fire, and the fire which will be born from separation, and by it, like the yogis whose bodies have been burnt, we shall attain to Thy abode by meditation at the nearest place.
35.translation: So Ang! O Krishna! Sprinkle us with the fire of desire in our hearts, which has been kindled by the nectar of Your lips, by Your smile, by Your gaze and by Your song. If this is not so much the one fire, and the fire which will be born from separation, and by it, like the yogis whose bodies have been burnt, we shall attain to Thy abode by meditation at the nearest place.

36.word_for_word: ननु स्व-पतीन् एवोपगच्छत । — Indeed, she should approach her husbands.; त एनम् अग्निं सिञ्चेयुर् इति चेत्, तत्राहुः---यर्हि इति । — If they say that they should sprinkle this fire, they say, "When.; रमाया लक्ष्म्या दत्त-क्षणं दत्तोत्सवं दत्तावसरं वा । — A moment given by Rama and Lakshmi, a festival given or an opportunity given.; तद् अपि क्वचिद् एव न सर्वदा । — Even that is sometimes not always the case.; अरण्य-जनाः प्रिया यस्य, तस्य तव । — The people of the forest are dear to you.; अरण्य-जन-प्रियत्वाद् अरण्ये क्वचिद् यर्ह्य् अस्प्राक्ष्म स्पृष्टवत्यो वयं, तत्र च त्वयाभिरमिता आनन्दिताः सत्यस् तद् आरभ्य अन्य-समक्षं स्थातुम् अपि न पारयामः । — Because of our love for the people of the forest, we have touched the untouchable somewhere in the forest, and there we have been delighted and delighted by you, and since then we have not been able to stand in front of anyone else.; तुच्छास् ते न रोचन्त इत्य् अर्थः ॥३६॥ — This means that they do not like the insignificant.
36.translation: Indeed, she should approach her husbands. If they say that they should sprinkle this fire, they say, "When. A moment given by Rama and Lakshmi, a festival given or an opportunity given. Even that is sometimes not always the case. The people of the forest are dear to you. Because of our love for the people of the forest, we have touched the untouchable somewhere in the forest, and there we have been delighted and delighted by you, and since then we have not been able to stand in front of anyone else. This means that they do not like the insignificant.

37.word_for_word: त्वत्-पाद-सौभाग्यं त्व् अतिचित्रम् इत्य् आहुः---श्रीर् इति । — They say that the fortune of your feet is very wonderful, and that you are beautiful.; वक्षस्य् असापत्न्यं स्थानं लब्ध्वापि, तुलस्या सपत्न्या सह तव पादाम्बुज-रजः कामयते स्म । — Even though I had found a place on my chest without a wife, I longed for the dust of your lotus feet with my consort Tulsi.; भृत्यैः सर्वैर् जुष्टम् इति सौभाग्यातिरेकोक्तिः । — It is an expression of good fortune that it is enjoyed by all its servants; यस्याः स्व-वीक्षण-कृते श्रीर् आत्मानं विलोकयत्व् इत्य् एतद्-अर्थम् अन्येषां [सुराणां] ब्रह्मादीनां तपोभिः प्रयासः, सा तद्-रजः, तद्वद् वयम् अपि प्रपन्ना इति ॥३७॥ — The dust of which other [demigods], such as Brahma, have endeavored by austerities for this purpose, that the goddess of fortune may look upon herself for the sake of her own gaze, is that dust, and in the same way we have surrendered to her.
37.translation: They say that the fortune of your feet is very wonderful, and that you are beautiful. Even though I had found a place on my chest without a wife, I longed for the dust of your lotus feet with my consort Tulsi. It is an expression of good fortune that it is enjoyed by all its servants The dust of which other [demigods], such as Brahma, have endeavored by austerities for this purpose, that the goddess of fortune may look upon herself for the sake of her own gaze, is that dust, and in the same way we have surrendered to her.

38.word_for_word:
हे वृजिनार्दन दुःख-हन्तः ! — O Vrijinardana, destroyer of suffering!; त्वद्-उपासने त्वद्-भजन एव आशा यासां ता वयं वसतीर् गृहान् विसृज्य हित्वा योगिन इव प्राप्ताः । — We have left our dwellings and homes, whose only hope is to worship You, and have become like yogīs.; तव सुन्दर-स्मित-विलसित-निरीक्षणेन यस् तीव्रः कामः, तेन तप्त-चित्तानाम् । — The intense desire that comes from your beautiful smile and your charming gaze is what burns their hearts.; हे पुरुष-रत्न ! — O Purusha-ratna!; दास्यं देहि ॥३८॥ — Give me a maidservant.; : निषेध-पक्षे वृजिनार्द न इति च्छेदः, गृहादि त्यक्त्वा न प्राप्ता
वयम् इति योजना । — On the side of prohibition, the cut is not Vrijinard, leaving the house and other things and not getting it
We are the plan.
38.translation:
O Vrijinardana, destroyer of suffering! We have left our dwellings and homes, whose only hope is to worship You, and have become like yogīs. The intense desire that comes from your beautiful smile and your charming gaze is what burns their hearts. O Purusha-ratna! Give me a maidservant. On the side of prohibition, the cut is not Vrijinard, leaving the house and other things and not getting it
We are the plan.

39.word_for_word: ननु, गृह-स्वाम्यं विहाय दास्यं किम् इति प्रार्थ्यते ? — Indeed, what is being prayed for as a slave apart from house-ownership?; त आहुः---वीक्ष्य इति । — They say, "Look at it.; अलकावृत-मुखं केशान्तरैर् आवृत-मुखम् । — His face was covered with scarves and his hair was covered with hair.; तथा कुण्डलयोः श्रीर् ययोः, ते गण्ड-स्थले यस्मिन्, अधरे सुधा यस्मिन्, तच् च तच् च तव मुखं वीक्ष्य, दत्ताभयं भुज-दण्ड-युग्मं वक्षश् च श्रिया एकम् एव रमणं रति-जनकं वीक्ष्य, दास्य एव भवाम इति ॥३९॥ — Similarly, seeing the beauty of the earrings, the nectar on your cheeks, the nectar on your lips, the pair of arms and rods given to you, the pair of arms and staffs given to you, and the chest of beauty, the only delightful source of attraction, we shall become your servants.
39.translation: Indeed, what is being prayed for as a slave apart from house-ownership? They say, "Look at it. His face was covered with scarves and his hair was covered with hair. Similarly, seeing the beauty of the earrings, the nectar on your cheeks, the nectar on your lips, the pair of arms and rods given to you, the pair of arms and staffs given to you, and the chest of beauty, the only delightful source of attraction, we shall become your servants.

40.word_for_word: ननु जुगुप्सितम् औपपत्यम् [भा।पु। — Indeed, the despicable approach [Bh.p.; १०.२९.२६] इत्य् उक्तम्, तत्राहुः---का स्त्री इति । — 10.29.26] It is said, and they say, "What is a woman?"; अङ्ग ! — Ang!; हे कृष्ण ! — O Krishna!; कलानि पदानि यस्मिंस् तद् आयतं दीर्घं मूर्च्छितं स्वरालाप-भेदः, तेन । — The arts and steps in which that rectangle is long and faint are the differences in vocal speech, by that.; पाठान्तरे, \"कल-पदामृत\"-मयं \"वेणु-गीतं\", तेन संमोहिता का वा स्त्री आर्य-चरितान् निज-धर्मान् न चलेत् ? — In another text, what woman, fascinated by the \"flute song\" of \"the nectar of the lotus feet\", would not follow the noble characters and her own religions?; यन्-मोहिताः पुरुषा अपि चलिताः । — Even men who were fascinated by it moved.; किं च, त्रैलोक्य-सौभगम् इति यद् यतः अबिभ्रन्न् अबिभ्रुः । — What is more, they did not carry whatever they carried, which is called the three-worldly auspiciousness.; त्वद्-द्योतक-शब्द-श्रवण-मात्रेणापि तावन् निज-धर्म-त्यागो युक्तः, किं पुनस् त्वद्-अनुभवेनेति भावः ॥४०॥ — Even by merely hearing the words signifying You, it is proper to renounce one’s own religious duties, what to speak of experiencing You, this means.
40.translation: Indeed, the despicable approach [Bh.p. 10.29.26] It is said, and they say, "What is a woman?" Ang! O Krishna! The arts and steps in which that rectangle is long and faint are the differences in vocal speech, by that. In another text, what woman, fascinated by the \"flute song\" of \"the nectar of the lotus feet\", would not follow the noble characters and her own religions? Even men who were fascinated by it moved. What is more, they did not carry whatever they carried, which is called the three-worldly auspiciousness. Even by merely hearing the words signifying You, it is proper to renounce one’s own religious duties, what to speak of experiencing You, this means.

41.word_for_word: व्यक्तं निश्चितम् ॥४१॥ — It is manifest and certain.

42.word_for_word: विक्लवितं पारवश्य-प्रलपितम् । — They were disturbed and talked about being under the control of others.; गोपीर् अरीरमद् रमयामास ॥४२॥ — The gopis entertained the enemy.
42.translation: They were disturbed and talked about being under the control of others. The gopis entertained the enemy.

43.word_for_word: प्रियस्य ईक्षणेन उत्फुल्लानि मुखानि यासां, ताभिः । — By those whose faces are blossoming at the sight of their beloved.; उदार-हासश् च द्विजाश् च तेषु कुन्द-कुसुमवद् दीधितिर् यस्य सः । — He had a generous smile and a radiance like the flowers of a kunda tree among the brāhmaṇas; एणाङ्कश् चन्द्रः ॥४३॥ — Enaṅka is the moon.
43.translation: By those whose faces are blossoming at the sight of their beloved. He had a generous smile and a radiance like the flowers of a kunda tree among the brāhmaṇas Enaṅka is the moon.

46.word_for_word: बाहु-प्रसारश् च परिरम्भश् च करादीनाम् आलभनं स्पर्शश् च नर्म परिहासश् च नखाग्र-पातश् च तैः । — They extended their arms, embraced them, touched them with their hands, touched them, joked with them, and dropped the tips of their nails.; क्ष्वेल्या क्रीडया । — By playing with jokes.; अवलोकैश् च हसितैश् च कामं तासाम् उद्दीपयंस् ता रमयामास ॥४६॥ — He delighted them with his looks and laughter, arousing their lust.
46.translation: They extended their arms, embraced them, touched them with their hands, touched them, joked with them, and dropped the tips of their nails. By playing with jokes. He delighted them with his looks and laughter, arousing their lust.

47.word_for_word: महात्मनो विमुक्त-चित्तात् ॥४७॥ — From the liberated mind of the great soul.
47.translation: From the liberated mind of the great soul.

48.word_for_word: तत् सौभगेन मदम् अस्वाधीनताम् । — That’s luckily independence.; मानं गर्वम् । — Honor and pride.; केशवः कश् च ईशश् च, तौ वशयतीति तथा सः ॥४८ ॥ — Who is Keshava and who is the Lord, and so he subdues both.; इति श्रीमद्-भागवते महा-पुराणे दशम-स्कन्धे पूर्वार्धे — This is the first half of the tenth Skanda of the Maha-Purana in the Srimad-Bhagavatam; भावार्थ-दीपिकायां टीकायाम् एकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥२९॥ — This is the thirty-ninth chapter of the commentary on the Bhavartha-dipika.
48.translation: That’s luckily independence. Honor and pride. Who is Keshava and who is the Lord, and so he subdues both. This is the first half of the tenth Skanda of the Maha-Purana in the Srimad-Bhagavatam This is the thirty-ninth chapter of the commentary on the Bhavartha-dipika.
